_comment: Bench basename -> public model id; null = not published. Overrides the default (the run's version prefix) for runs whose prefix is not a model version. Kept out of static/, so it is never deployed.
_unpublished_prefixes_comment: Bench basenames starting with any of these are never published (experiment campaigns: ea_ = EMA-vs-leaf, issue #18; ab_ = the up16 A/B and its cd600 extension, whose best-of composite is published as v61; wb_ = the wrist-body experiment's single runs, whose best-of composite is published as v62; wb2_ = its repeat with depth-init + encoder Muon, whose best-of composite is published as v63; wb2x_ = the wb2 trunk extended to update 4750 and re-leafed, whose best-of composite is published as v63x: since 2026-10-03 the six-bench best6, which adds the leaf-fit body with wrist bend tau 1.7 N.m at 30 and 60 Hz; the original best4 is unpublished; wb3_ = the v63x trunk extended to update 7750 on exp/wrist-body-90 (wrist bend cap 90 rad/s, default bend 1.80 N.m) and re-leafed, whose best-of composite is published as v63x2; arch_ = the 2026-10-03 architecture A/B arms (baseline, residual fixes, DenseFormer, SimBaV2 trunk), experiments only; bend7_ = the 2026-10-04 wrist-bend experiment: 7 bend gears, 2.07 N.m, 105 rad/s). v56_-v59_: models before v60, removed from the site 2026-10-02 (user).
